propositions: No Jira Data Center license or official OpenAPI spec is available, leaving a DC adapter unverifiable except against self-referential fakes.
Use the pinned pycontribs/jira-test-image:8.17.1 Docker image as a licensed, pullable real-Jira oracle reachable at localhost:2990/jira.
Jira 8.17.1 (>=8.14) exercises real Personal Access Token bearer auth, the DC transport's auth mode.
The harness proves REST v2 protocol semantics only, not deployment-specific behavior, with real-instance validation deferred to ticket 9895-ac7d-4276-4f08.
Teardown must verify deletion via direct issue REST endpoints polling for 404, never via search-index queries, per ADR 0037 §3.
All tests carry the existing integration marker so make test excludes them by construction with no Makefile test-target change.
